module: World Editor decal editor ("Edit Decal" edit mode, "Decal Editor" window, "DecalEditor" action map). Two tabs: "Templates" (list of DecalData with * for modified ones; create, delete, save one or all templates) and "Instances" (list and properties of placed decals, template replacement, duplication). In Templates mode, a click on the terrain creates an instance of the selected template; instances are visualized by debug spheres colored by id, selectable with the mouse (Ctrl+click = multi-selection) and movable with the axis gizmo (Shift + drag = duplicate). All actions are undoable via editor.history, and decals are saved before the level is saved.
notes: The DummyDecal and tireTrackDecal templates are hidden from the list.
Debug distances: spheres up to 250 m, texts up to 50 m; sphere opacity is set with the "Gizmo sphere alpha" slider.
A spatial grid of cells speeds up the search for visible and hovered decals; it is rebuilt when the number of decals changes.
The gizmo is placed on the average of the selected instances' positions, or on the instance's world matrix in local alignment with a single selection.
Possible error: in onEditorInspectorFieldChanged, the result of scenetree.findObjectById is not checked before template:getClassName() (inferred from code).

onEditorAxisGizmoAligmentChanged.desc: Hook called when the gizmo alignment (local/world) changes; if instances are selected in Edit Decal mode, repositions the gizmo.

onEditorBeforeSaveLevel.desc: Hook called before the level is saved; saves all decal templates (editor.saveDecals).

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every editor frame; if the Edit Decal mode is active, draws the window (sphere opacity slider, "Show info labels" checkbox, Templates and Instances tabs).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: declares editor.editModes.decalEditMode (onActivate, onDeactivate, onUpdate, onDeleteSelection, create_decal icon, auxiliary shortcuts) and registers the 400x600 window.

onEditorInspectorFieldChanged.desc: Hook called when a field changes in the inspector; for each modified DecalData, marks it dirty in scenetree.decalPersistMan and notifies the instances that use it (editor.notifyDecalModified).

onEditorInspectorHeaderGui.desc: Hook called to draw the inspector header; in Edit Decal mode, shows the material preview of the selected template.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension is loaded; writes "initialized" to the log.
